summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $1.0 billion offering of 5.908% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Notes due 2032. The notes price at par, pay semi-annually from April 16, 2027, reset on October 16, 2031 to the U.S. Treasury Rate plus 0.900%, and mature October 16, 2032. They are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations, callable in whole but not in part, and subject to UK bail-in powers; NYSE listing is intended. This is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation.
